evidence: src/infrastructure/config/container.ts: buildControllers() is documented as 'Composition root: the single place where abstractions are bound to implementations' and calls seedCatalogue(products) after creating InMemoryProductRepository.
src/infrastructure/config/seedCatalogue.ts: seedCatalogue(products: ProductRepository) depends on the domain repository interface, not on a concrete class.

src/infrastructure/config/seedCatalogue.ts: products are built with Product.create({... unitPrice: Money.ofCents(item.unitPriceCents) ...}), which goes through domain factories and keeps their invariants.
The CATALOGUE constant appears only in seedCatalogue.ts, and the wiring appears only in container.ts, so neither is duplicated.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: Both files deal with one concern: bootstrapping the application. container.ts is the composition root. buildControllers() creates the repositories, services and use cases and connects them, and it calls seedCatalogue to put initial data into the product repository. seedCatalogue.ts holds that startup data. It goes through the module's abstractions instead of around them: it depends on the ProductRepository interface, not on the in-memory implementation, and builds products with the domain factories Product.create and Money.ofCents instead of making raw objects. Each rule lives in one place. The catalogue data exists only in seedCatalogue.ts, and the wiring between abstractions and implementations exists only in buildControllers. Neither file repeats a business rule or invariant.
